# DigiePages

> DigiePages provides hyper-local digital marketing for local businesses: hyper-local directories, Google Business Profile optimization, local ad products, and lead attribution.

## Services
- [Hyper-Local Directories](https://digiepages.com/services/local-directories): town, area, and category directory sites with schema markup.
- [Google Business Profile Engine](https://digiepages.com/services/google-business-profile): setup, posts, reviews, and insights.
- [Digital Ad Products](https://digiepages.com/services/local-ads): Local Services Ads, Maps and Search, and Meta geo-targeted campaigns.
- [Lead Attribution](https://digiepages.com/services/lead-attribution): call tracking and channel reporting.
